property: FTP control commands and replies explicitly use Telnet protocol/end-of-line conventions even though file data is transferred over a separate FTP data connection.

date_or_range.notes: The relationship is explicit in RFC 959.

sources.locator: RFC 959 Relationship between FTP and Telnet; FTP command syntax
sources.supports: explicit Telnet use on FTP control connection

negative_claims: FTP is not a Telnet protocol revision.
FTP data connections do not become Telnet sessions merely because the control channel uses Telnet conventions.
open_questions: Trace whether early FTP implementations reused common Telnet code modules or merely reimplemented the wire conventions.
notes: A concrete cross-protocol convention inheritance edge.
